note: Course Directory reference catalogue for Atlas. Educational overview only — no cut-offs or eligibility claims. Expand by appending programmes.

programmes.name: MBChB Medicine
programmes.brief: Train as a medical doctor with clinical rotations and biomedical science foundations.
programmes.detailed_overview: Medicine combines biomedical science with supervised clinical practice. Students study the structure and function of the human body, disease processes, and patient care across hospital and community settings. Graduates typically complete internship and residency pathways before independent practice.

programmes.name: BSc Nursing
programmes.brief: Prepare for professional nursing with patient care, clinical skills, and health promotion.
programmes.detailed_overview: Nursing programmes develop clinical judgment, compassionate care, and evidence-based practice through ward and community placements.

programmes.name: Doctor of Pharmacy / BPharm
programmes.brief: Study medicines, patient counselling, and pharmaceutical science for community or hospital pharmacy.
programmes.detailed_overview: Pharmacy education covers how medicines are designed, dispensed, and used safely across hospitals, community pharmacies, industry, and regulation.

programmes.name: BSc Medical Laboratory Science
programmes.brief: Learn diagnostic laboratory techniques used to detect and monitor disease.
programmes.detailed_overview: Students learn to analyse blood, tissues, and other specimens that guide clinical decisions, with strong emphasis on biosafety and quality control.

programmes.name: BSc Physician Assistantship
programmes.brief: Train to support physicians in diagnosis, treatment, and primary care delivery.
programmes.detailed_overview: Physician assistant programmes blend medical science with practical clinical training under physician supervision.

programmes.name: BSc Physiotherapy and Sports Science
programmes.brief: Restore movement and function through rehabilitation science and therapeutic exercise.
programmes.detailed_overview: Students study how the body moves and recovers, then apply exercise and education to help patients regain function.

programmes.name: BSc Midwifery
programmes.brief: Specialise in pregnancy, childbirth, and newborn care in clinical and community settings.
programmes.detailed_overview: Midwifery focuses on safe motherhood and newborn wellbeing, including emergency obstetric skills and family health education.

programmes.name: BSc Dental Surgery
programmes.brief: Study oral health, dental procedures, and preventive dentistry.
programmes.detailed_overview: Dental programmes combine biomedical science with clinical dentistry to diagnose and treat oral disease.

programmes.name: DVM Veterinary Medicine
programmes.brief: Care for animal health across companion, livestock, and public-health contexts.
programmes.detailed_overview: Veterinary medicine covers animal care plus disease control that protects both animal and human health.

programmes.name: BSc Public Health
programmes.brief: Prevent disease and improve population health through epidemiology and health systems.
programmes.detailed_overview: Public health looks beyond individual patients to communities and systems that reduce disease burden.

programmes.name: BSc Nutrition and Dietetics
programmes.brief: Apply food science and clinical nutrition to promote health and manage disease.
programmes.detailed_overview: Students learn how nutrients affect the body and how tailored diets support wellness and recovery.

programmes.name: BSc Medical Imaging
programmes.brief: Produce and interpret medical images that support diagnosis and treatment.
programmes.detailed_overview: Medical imaging trains students to operate equipment safely and produce diagnostic-quality images.

programmes.name: BSc Herbal Medicine
programmes.brief: Study medicinal plants and integrative approaches within a scientific framework.
programmes.detailed_overview: This programme connects ethnobotany and laboratory science for responsible plant-based therapies.

programmes.name: BSc Optometry
programmes.brief: Examine eyes, prescribe corrective lenses, and manage common visual disorders.
programmes.detailed_overview: Optometry blends optics with clinical eye care for vision assessment and ocular health.

programmes.name: BSc Computer Engineering
programmes.brief: Design computing hardware and embedded systems at the intersection of EE and CS.
programmes.detailed_overview: Computer engineering focuses on how hardware and low-level software work together in modern devices.

programmes.name: BSc Electrical Engineering
programmes.brief: Design and analyse electrical power, electronics, and control systems.
programmes.detailed_overview: Students learn to generate, distribute, and use electrical energy across industry and infrastructure.

programmes.name: BSc Civil Engineering
programmes.brief: Plan and build infrastructure such as roads, bridges, water systems, and structures.
programmes.detailed_overview: Civil engineering trains graduates to design resilient infrastructure for communities.

programmes.name: BSc Mechanical Engineering
programmes.brief: Design machines, thermal systems, and manufacturing processes.
programmes.detailed_overview: Mechanical engineers apply physics and design methods to engines, plants, tools, and production lines.

programmes.name: BSc Chemical Engineering
programmes.brief: Turn raw materials into useful products through chemical process design.
programmes.detailed_overview: Chemical engineering connects chemistry with large-scale process design for fuels, foods, and materials.

programmes.name: BSc Biomedical Engineering
programmes.brief: Apply engineering to medical devices, diagnostics, and healthcare technology.
programmes.detailed_overview: Biomedical engineering sits between medicine and engineering, focusing on devices that diagnose or treat patients.

programmes.name: BSc Aerospace Engineering
programmes.brief: Study aircraft and related aerospace systems, aerodynamics, and propulsion.
programmes.detailed_overview: Aerospace programmes emphasise fluid mechanics, structures, and systems engineering for flight technologies.

programmes.name: BSc Petroleum Engineering
programmes.brief: Explore oil and gas exploration, drilling, and production engineering.
programmes.detailed_overview: Students learn how hydrocarbons are located and produced with attention to safety and efficiency.

programmes.name: BSc Telecommunication Engineering
programmes.brief: Design communication networks, wireless systems, and signal transmission.
programmes.detailed_overview: Telecom engineering covers how voice, data, and media move across wired and wireless networks.

programmes.name: BSc Materials Engineering
programmes.brief: Study metals, polymers, ceramics, and materials processing for industry.
programmes.detailed_overview: Materials engineers select and improve materials so products are stronger, lighter, or more sustainable.

programmes.name: BSc Geological Engineering
programmes.brief: Apply geology to engineering problems in mining, construction, and resources.
programmes.detailed_overview: This field connects earth science with engineering design for tunnels, foundations, and mining.

programmes.name: BSc Industrial Engineering
programmes.brief: Optimise people, processes, and systems for productivity and quality.
programmes.detailed_overview: Industrial engineering focuses on efficiency — designing workflows and improving organisational performance.

programmes.name: BSc Marine Engineering
programmes.brief: Engineering systems for ships and marine operations.
programmes.detailed_overview: Marine engineering prepares graduates for propulsion and mechanical systems that keep vessels operating safely.

programmes.name: BSc Automobile Engineering
programmes.brief: Design, diagnose, and improve automotive systems and vehicle technology.
programmes.detailed_overview: Automobile programmes blend mechanical and electrical systems for modern vehicles.

programmes.name: BSc Computer Science
programmes.brief: Study algorithms, software development, and computing theory for modern applications.
programmes.detailed_overview: Computer Science builds problem-solving skills through coding, theory, and systems design for digital solutions.

programmes.name: BSc Information Technology
programmes.brief: Apply computing to organisational systems, networks, and user-focused IT services.
programmes.detailed_overview: IT programmes emphasise practical systems organisations rely on — networks, databases, and digital services.

programmes.name: BSc Information Systems
programmes.brief: Bridge business needs and technology through systems analysis and data management.
programmes.detailed_overview: Information Systems focuses on how organisations use technology to make decisions and run operations.

programmes.name: BSc Cyber Security
programmes.brief: Protect systems and data through security engineering, risk, and ethical hacking foundations.
programmes.detailed_overview: Cybersecurity trains students to identify threats, harden systems, and respond to incidents.

programmes.name: BSc Data Science
programmes.brief: Turn data into insight using statistics, programming, and machine learning foundations.
programmes.detailed_overview: Data science combines maths and computing to clean, analyse, and communicate patterns from datasets.

programmes.name: BSc Software Engineering
programmes.brief: Engineer reliable software with design patterns, testing, and team development practices.
programmes.detailed_overview: Software engineering emphasises maintainable products — process, quality, and collaboration as well as coding.

programmes.name: BSc Computer Networking
programmes.brief: Design and manage computer networks and internet infrastructure.
programmes.detailed_overview: Networking programmes prepare graduates to keep organisations connected through reliable infrastructure.

programmes.name: BSc Business Administration
programmes.brief: Build broad management skills across marketing, finance, HR, and operations.
programmes.detailed_overview: Business Administration gives a versatile foundation for leading teams and organisations.

programmes.name: BSc Accounting
programmes.brief: Master financial reporting, auditing, and management accounting for organisations.
programmes.detailed_overview: Accounting programmes train students to measure and communicate financial performance with ethics and precision.

programmes.name: BSc Banking and Finance
programmes.brief: Understand banks, financial markets, investments, and corporate finance.
programmes.detailed_overview: Students learn how money moves through banks and markets, and how firms raise and manage capital.

programmes.name: BA / BSc Economics
programmes.brief: Analyse how societies allocate resources using micro and macroeconomics.
programmes.detailed_overview: Economics develops analytical tools for markets, policy, and development challenges.

programmes.name: BSc Marketing
programmes.brief: Create value for customers through branding, research, and digital marketing.
programmes.detailed_overview: Marketing programmes blend creativity and analytics to position products and reach audiences.

programmes.name: BSc Human Resource Management
programmes.brief: Manage people systems: recruitment, performance, training, and labour relations.
programmes.detailed_overview: HRM focuses on productive workplaces through fair policies and talent development.

programmes.name: BSc Entrepreneurship
programmes.brief: Launch and grow ventures with opportunity recognition, finance, and innovation skills.
programmes.detailed_overview: Entrepreneurship programmes train students to spot opportunities, build ventures, and manage risk. You study business models, finance for startups, marketing, and innovation. Graduates often launch their own firms or work in SME development, incubators, and corporate innovation teams across Ghana and beyond.

programmes.name: BSc Logistics and Supply Chain Management
programmes.brief: Coordinate procurement, logistics, and inventory across local and global networks.
programmes.detailed_overview: Supply chain education prepares graduates to move goods efficiently while managing cost and risk.

programmes.name: BSc Actuarial Science
programmes.brief: Use mathematics and statistics to price risk in insurance and finance.
programmes.detailed_overview: Actuarial science is highly quantitative — modelling uncertainty for pensions, insurance, and financial risk.

programmes.name: BSc Hospitality Management
programmes.brief: Run hotels, tourism services, and guest experience operations.
programmes.detailed_overview: Hospitality programmes combine service excellence with business operations for tourism.

programmes.name: BSc Procurement and Supply Chain
programmes.brief: Specialise in purchasing strategy, contracts, and supplier management.
programmes.detailed_overview: Procurement training emphasises value for money, ethics, and supplier relationships.

programmes.name: BSc Insurance
programmes.brief: Study risk transfer, underwriting, claims, and insurance markets.
programmes.detailed_overview: Insurance programmes prepare graduates to help individuals and firms manage financial risk.

programmes.name: BSc Biological Sciences
programmes.brief: Explore living systems from cells to ecosystems with laboratory practice.
programmes.detailed_overview: Biological Sciences builds life-science literacy for research, health pathways, and environmental careers.

programmes.name: BSc Chemistry
programmes.brief: Study matter, reactions, and chemical analysis in laboratory settings.
programmes.detailed_overview: Chemistry programmes train precise experimental skills used in industry, research, and regulation.

programmes.name: BSc Physics
programmes.brief: Investigate energy, matter, and physical laws with mathematical modelling.
programmes.detailed_overview: Physics develops quantitative reasoning useful in technology, research, and engineering-adjacent roles.

programmes.name: BSc Mathematics
programmes.brief: Develop abstract and applied mathematical reasoning for science and industry.
programmes.detailed_overview: Mathematics sharpens logical thinking that underpins computing, finance, teaching, and modelling.

programmes.name: BSc Statistics
programmes.brief: Collect, analyse, and interpret data for research and decision-making.
programmes.detailed_overview: Statistics programmes prepare graduates to design studies and draw trustworthy conclusions from data.

programmes.name: BSc Biochemistry
programmes.brief: Study the chemistry of life — proteins, metabolism, and molecular biology.
programmes.detailed_overview: Biochemistry links chemistry and biology for labs, health sciences, and biotechnology.

programmes.name: BSc Environmental Science
programmes.brief: Analyse environmental problems and sustainability solutions.
programmes.detailed_overview: Environmental Science combines field and lab work to support sustainable development.

programmes.name: BSc Food Science and Technology
programmes.brief: Apply science to food safety, processing, and product development.
programmes.detailed_overview: Food science prepares graduates for safe and innovative food products in industry and regulation.

programmes.name: BSc Agriculture
programmes.brief: Improve crop and livestock systems for food security and rural livelihoods.
programmes.detailed_overview: Agriculture programmes blend science and practice so graduates can raise productivity sustainably.

programmes.name: BSc Agricultural Engineering
programmes.brief: Engineer tools, irrigation, and post-harvest systems for farming.
programmes.detailed_overview: Agricultural engineering applies mechanical and civil principles to farm productivity.

programmes.name: BSc Natural Resources Management
programmes.brief: Manage forests, wildlife, and land resources responsibly.
programmes.detailed_overview: Students learn stewardship of forests, water, and biodiversity alongside community livelihoods.

programmes.name: BSc Aquaculture and Fisheries
programmes.brief: Produce and manage fish and aquatic resources sustainably.
programmes.detailed_overview: Aquaculture focuses on farming fish and other aquatic organisms sustainably. Students learn hatchery methods, water quality, feeding, disease control, and farm economics. Careers include fish farm management, extension services, feed supply, and roles in food security and environmental agencies.

programmes.name: BSc Agribusiness
programmes.brief: Run agricultural value chains with business and market skills.
programmes.detailed_overview: Agribusiness connects farming to markets through finance, logistics, and entrepreneurship.

programmes.name: BSc Meteorology and Climate Science
programmes.brief: Understand climate systems and adaptation strategies for communities.
programmes.detailed_overview: These programmes prepare graduates to interpret climate data and support adaptation planning.

programmes.name: BSc Architecture
programmes.brief: Design buildings and spaces that are functional, safe, and culturally responsive.
programmes.detailed_overview: Architecture blends creativity and technical knowledge through studio-based learning.

programmes.name: BSc Quantity Surveying
programmes.brief: Manage construction costs, contracts, and project finances.
programmes.detailed_overview: Quantity surveying keeps construction projects financially controlled from tender to completion.

programmes.name: BSc Human Settlement Planning
programmes.brief: Plan towns and regions for orderly, sustainable development.
programmes.detailed_overview: Planning programmes train graduates to shape cities through policy, maps, and engagement.

programmes.name: BSc Land Economy
programmes.brief: Study land markets, valuation, and real estate economics.
programmes.detailed_overview: Land Economy blends property valuation, land administration, and real-estate economics. You study land law, surveying basics, investment appraisal, and development planning. Graduates work in valuation firms, banks, estate agencies, and public land commissions.

programmes.name: BSc Construction Technology and Management
programmes.brief: Deliver building projects through construction methods and site management.
programmes.detailed_overview: Construction programmes emphasise practical delivery with quality, safety, and scheduling.

programmes.name: BEd Basic Education
programmes.brief: Prepare to teach and support learning at the basic school level.
programmes.detailed_overview: Basic Education programmes prepare teachers for primary and junior high classrooms. Coursework covers child development, pedagogy, curriculum, and subject methods. Graduates typically teach in schools or move into education administration, curriculum support, and community learning programmes.

programmes.name: BEd Secondary Education
programmes.brief: Train as a secondary school teacher in specialised subject areas.
related_shs_subjects: Strong SHS electives in teaching subject
programmes.detailed_overview: Secondary education programmes deepen content knowledge and classroom skills for SHS teaching.

programmes.name: BEd Early Childhood Education
programmes.brief: Support learning and care for young children in the early years.
programmes.detailed_overview: Early childhood programmes emphasise nurturing environments for lifelong learning foundations.

programmes.name: BEd Special Education
programmes.brief: Teach and support learners with diverse educational needs.
programmes.detailed_overview: Special Education prepares teachers to adapt instruction so every learner can progress.

programmes.name: BA / BSc Psychology
programmes.brief: Study behaviour and mental processes with research and applied foundations.
programmes.detailed_overview: Psychology builds insight into human behaviour useful in education, health, and business.

programmes.name: BA Sociology
programmes.brief: Analyse social structures, change, and community life.
programmes.detailed_overview: Sociology helps graduates understand institutions and inequality in development work.

programmes.name: BA Political Science
programmes.brief: Study government, power, and public affairs.
programmes.detailed_overview: Political Science prepares students for civic leadership and careers around governance.

programmes.name: BA Geography and Resource Development
programmes.brief: Explore people–environment relationships and spatial development.
programmes.detailed_overview: Geography and Development explores how people, places, and resources interact. You study physical and human geography, GIS, environmental management, and development planning. Careers include urban planning support, NGOs, environmental consulting, and research or policy roles.

programmes.name: BA Social Work
programmes.brief: Support individuals and communities through professional social services.
programmes.detailed_overview: Social Work trains practitioners to advocate for vulnerable people and deliver support.

programmes.name: BA History
programmes.brief: Investigate the past to understand societies and identity.
programmes.detailed_overview: History develops critical reading and writing skills for education and culture careers.

programmes.name: BA English / French / Linguistics
programmes.brief: Deepen language skills for communication, teaching, and cultural work.
programmes.detailed_overview: Language programmes develop advanced communication, literature, and cultural analysis skills in one or more languages. Students practise translation, linguistics, and critical reading. Graduates work in teaching, media, diplomacy support, translation, publishing, and international organisations.

programmes.name: BA International Relations
programmes.brief: Study diplomacy, global politics, and international organisations.
programmes.detailed_overview: International Relations prepares students to analyse global affairs and development work.

programmes.name: BA Communication Studies
programmes.brief: Create and manage media messages across journalism, PR, and digital platforms.
programmes.detailed_overview: Communication Studies trains clear storytelling for newsrooms, brands, and public institutions.

programmes.name: BA Fine Art
programmes.brief: Develop studio practice in drawing, painting, sculpture, and visual expression.
programmes.detailed_overview: Fine Art centres creative practice and critical thinking through intensive studio work.

programmes.name: BA Communication Design
programmes.brief: Design visual identities, publications, and digital interfaces.
programmes.detailed_overview: Design programmes teach how visuals communicate clearly for business, culture, and the web.

programmes.name: BA Theatre Arts / Film and Television
programmes.brief: Tell stories through performance, directing, and screen production.
programmes.detailed_overview: These programmes blend creative storytelling with production skills for stage and screen.

programmes.name: BA Music
programmes.brief: Study performance, theory, and musicology with practical ensembles.
programmes.detailed_overview: Music degrees combine artistry and scholarship for performance, teaching, and culture.

programmes.name: BA Publishing Studies
programmes.brief: Manage the journey of text from manuscript to reader across print and digital.
programmes.detailed_overview: Publishing Studies prepares graduates for editorial and production roles in knowledge industries.

programmes.name: LLB Law
programmes.brief: Study the legal system, rights, and legal reasoning for advocacy and counsel.
programmes.detailed_overview: An LLB builds rigorous legal analysis. Graduates usually continue to professional training before practice.
